results.summary: Technical analysis is a method of evaluating securities by analyzing statistics generated from market activity, such as past prices and volume. Technical analysts believe that past market behaviour can be used to predict future market behaviour. Moving averages are an indicator that tracks the average price of a security over a specified period. The moving average convergence divergence (MACD) indicator is a technical analysis tool that is used to measure the momentum of a security. The relative strength index (RSI) is a technical analysis indicator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or over-sold conditions. The Fibonacci retracement is a technical analysis tool that is used to identify potential support and resistance levels. Bollinger bands are a technical analysis indicator that is used to measure the volatility of a security. Based on the technical analysis methods used, here are the scores out of 10: Moving Averages: 6, Moving Averages Convergence Divergence: 7, Relative Strength Index: 6, Fibonacci Retracement: 7, Bollinger Bands: 6.
